segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כֹּהֵן קוֹדֵם לְלֵוִי, לֵוִי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל, יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַמְזֵר, וּמַמְזֵר לְנָתִין, וְנָתִין לְגֵר, וְגֵר לְעֶבֶד מְשׁוּחְרָר. אֵימָתַי? בִּזְמַן שֶׁכּוּלָּם שָׁוִים. אֲבָל אִם הָיָה מַמְזֵר תַּלְמִיד חָכָם וְכֹהֵן גָּדוֹל עַם הָאָרֶץ – מַמְזֵר תַּלְמִיד חָכָם קוֹדֵם לְכֹהֵן גָּדוֹל עַם הָאָרֶץ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A priest precedes a Levite. A Levite» precedes «an Israelite. An Israelite» precedes «a son born from an incestuous or adulterous relationship [mamzer], and a mamzer» precedes «a Gibeonite, and a Gibeonite» precedes «a convert, and a convert» precedes «an emancipated slave. When» do these halakhot of precedence take effect? In circumstances «when they are all equal» in terms of wisdom. «But if there were a mamzer» who is «a Torah scholar and a High Priest» who is «an ignoramus, a mamzer» who is «a Torah scholar precedes a High Priest» who is «an ignoramus,» as Torah wisdom surpasses all else.

moves.summary: precedence: priest, Levite, Israelite, mamzer, Gibeonite, convert, freed slave
the order holds only when equal in wisdom; a scholar mamzer precedes an ignorant High Priest
